project_title: SIH 26008: MineGuard AI — Industrial Conveyor Belt Defect Detection and Monitoring System

system_architecture.orientation_handling: SmartOrientationRouter (Fast Path: single forward pass at 0 deg; Fallback Path: multi-view fusion at [0, 90, 270] deg with affine inverse transform)
system_architecture.hardware_state_machine: Deterministic 9-state FSM with persistent safety stop latch
system_architecture.hardware_mode: SIMULATION (Safe demonstration profile: physical 24V contactors de-energized)

performance_benchmarks.device_platform: LAPTOP CPU PERFORMANCE (Intel Core 12th Gen, 8 PyTorch threads)

known_limitations: Hardware mode is strictly SIMULATION (physical 24V contactors isolated for electrical safety in lab/hackathon room).

CPU inference latency on laptop is ~150-165ms (6-8 FPS dedicated, ~1.5 FPS during concurrent screen capture/browser); target industrial deployment on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano with TensorRT INT8 yields >30 FPS.
Dataset class balance: slight scratch and belt splice have fewer samples than longitudinal tear and normal belt.
